timeline.tweet: This weekend one of my closest friends’ boyfriend told me I was a shitty friend because we were out drinking and having a good time. I have been bubbling in anger since then.
I’m fully aware I’m freaking out over nothing but I don’t know how to stop my anxiety

I either down play now sick I am or I exaggerate. Like i'm either telling everyone i'm fine when I desperately need a doctor or i'm rolling on the floor like menstrual cramps are eating me from the inside out.
